359:t_1:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...For those reasons, the EVAs and their pilots who transferred here have agreed to cooperate with $c.」

359:t_1:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Now, please introduce yourselves again.」

359:t_1:6.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I'm $$渚カヲル$$. I pilot EVA Unit-13 together with $$シンジ$$.」

359:t_1:7.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「$$アヤナミレイ$$...」

359:t_1:8.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I'm $$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$. I'll be in your care for a while.」

359:t_1:9.en:
$$マリ$$
「I'm $$真希波・マリ・イラストリアス$$. Whether we know each other or not, I'm counting on you all.」

359:t_1:11.en:
$$赤木$$
「What's wrong, $$シンジ$$?! You seem down!」

359:t_1:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't get nervous now. It's only been three months since then.」

359:t_1:13.en:
$$シンジ$$
(We decided not to tell the people of $c that fourteen years have passed in our world...)

359:t_1:14.en:
$$シンジ$$
(But I'm just like them... I can't accept being told fourteen years passed when I woke up...)

359:t_1:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We'll use this $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ as our base to begin counteroffensive operations against the Empire and its allies.」

359:t_1:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But won't the Empire send troops right away...?」

359:t_1:17.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「There's no need to worry. The $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ will constantly change position, with jamming set to maximum.」

359:t_1:18.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If they locate us with those precautions in place, it could only be due to a traitor.」

359:t_1:19.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「It's reassuring to have a base this substantial.」

359:t_1:20.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Yeah... This really is the first step in our counteroffensive.」

359:t_1:21.en:
$$ブライト$$
「And our first strategic objective is to liberate $$翠の地球$$ from $$サイデリアル$$.」

359:t_1:22.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We're not going to $$蒼の地球$$...?」

359:t_1:23.en:
$$シャア$$
「The Empire now controls nearly 85%. Landing on $$蒼の地球$$ requires adequate preparation.」

359:t_1:24.en:
$$シャア$$
「If our entry brings the war to a stalemate, we must prevent the $$サイデリアル$$ left on $$翠の地球$$ from coming as reinforcements.」

359:t_1:25.en:
$$シャア$$
「Above all, we have almost no information about $$サイデリアル$$'s strategy.」

359:t_1:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So we'll gather information on $$サイデリアル$$ by retaking $$翠の地球$$, where their forces are relatively few...?」

359:t_1:28.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Even if we can't retake it, making them split forces from $$蒼の地球$$ to $$翠の地球$$ to face us would be worthwhile.」

359:t_1:29.en:
$$シャア$$
「Those are the operation's objectives. ...Does that satisfy you, $$カミーユ$$?」

359:t_1:31.en:
$$シャア$$
「We must also uncover the nature of the fundamental calamity we saw in that mysterious space.」

359:t_1:32.en:
$$シャア$$
「It's undoubtedly connected to $$サイデリアル$$. Gathering information on them should shed light on that, too.」

359:t_1:33.en:
$$フォウ$$
(Colonel $$シャア$$ has never taken the lead at a briefing before.)

359:t_1:34.en:
$$ファ$$
(Now that you mention it, you're right. Until now, he seemed more like an observer than a commander.)

359:t_1:35.en:
$$カツ$$
(Isn't that a good thing? That kind of role suits him, after all.)

359:t_1:36.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
(If even you approve of him, $$カツ$$, nobody in $c will complain.)

359:t_1:37.en:
$$ブライト$$
「You there...! No private conversations!」

359:t_1:39.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That concludes the briefing. Once we've assigned staff to guard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$, we'll head for $$翠の地球$$.」

359:t_1:40.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Until then, be ready for the unexpected. Dismissed...!」

359:t_1:41.en:
$$シンジ$$
(...Everyone's still fighting with a goal...)

359:t_1:42.en:
$$赤木$$
「It's a good thing your spare clothes were still on the $$クォーター$$, $$シンジ$$.」

359:t_1:44.en:
$$赤木$$
「What's wrong...? We're finally together again. You can hug me and bawl your eyes out, you know.」

359:t_1:47.en:
$$青山$$
(It seems $$赤木$$'s unsure how to approach $$シンジ$$ as he is now, too.)

359:t_1:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「When the $$時空震動$$ happened, I was prepared to part forever. Yet we're reunited after only three months.」

359:t_1:49.en:
$$甲児$$
「Are $$ミサト$$ and the others doing well? How are $$トウジ$$ and $$ケンスケ$$?」

359:t_1:51.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Our world's still in turmoil. There's a lot we don't know yet.」

359:t_1:52.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Then are $$ミサト$$ and the others missing?」

359:t_1:53.en:
$$カヲル$$
「But $$シンジ$$ believes he'll see them again.」

359:t_1:54.en:
$n
「That's right. After all, we've met again like this, too.」

359:t_1:56.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Does that EVA Unit-13 seat two people?」

359:t_1:57.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It has a $$ダブルエントリーシステム$$... It's a vessel for both $$シンジ$$'s soul and mine.」

359:t_1:60.en:
$n
(Is that because it was at the center of what we'd have to call $$サードインパクト$$...?)

359:t_1:61.en:
$$甲児$$
(We only knew EVAs up to Unit-03. Suddenly they've got 08, 09, and 13. $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ really worked hard.)

359:t_1:62.en:
$$カヲル$$
「$$シンジ$$'s father leads $$ＮＥＲＶ$$, after all. He'd do that much.」

359:t_1:63.en:
$n
「You heard that...? I thought I was speaking quietly...」

359:t_1:64.en:
$$カヲル$$
「No... But you're the type whose feelings show on your face.」

359:t_1:66.en:
$$アルト$$
「Is this any time to celebrate not being the quiet type anymore?!」

359:t_1:68.en:
$$ユノハ$$
(H-he has a rather unusual air about him.)

359:t_1:69.en:
$$サザンカ$$
(I wonder if he and $$シンジ$$ really have that kind of relationship...)

359:t_1:70.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
(Stop it, $$サザンカ$$...! He might be listening.)

359:t_1:71.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Then I might as well say it out loud.」

359:t_1:74.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hey, $$シンジ$$... $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ are here, too. Do you want to hear them sing live?」

359:t_1:75.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$'s here, too. Should we ask them to play something to get you fired up?」

359:t_1:76.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...I'm sorry. I'm tired, so I'll get some rest.」

359:t_1:77.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Y-yes... You're right. You've only just transferred here...」

359:t_1:78.en:
$$赤木$$
「Get plenty of rest, $$シンジ$$. It looks like things will get rough again from here on.」

359:t_1:80.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I'll go with $$シンジ$$, too. See you...」

359:t_1:81.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$シンジ$$... Something really is wrong with him...」

359:t_1:82.en:
$$さやか$$
「Yeah... He's gone back to being as timid as when we first met.」
